The physician may be found liable if the motion barrier was articulated more than 3 times, because repeated articulation at the barrier is a manipulative act that can injure the vertebral artery, and this replaces my earlier answer. The vignette does not state how many times the barrier was articulated, so this conclusion depends on a fact not in the case. Prior osteoarthritis treatment is the other option, but it is not mentioned in the vignette either.
CONFIDENCE: 35
